name: Clearlane Studio mobile app catalogue
availabilityNote: Store links are included only when listed on the canonical public profile. A product profile without a store link is not evidence of public availability.

apps.name: WealthMind: Budget & Finance
apps.description: Envelope budgets, net worth and a FIRE date in one offline budgeting app. No bank login, no account — your ledger stays in a database on your own phone.

apps.name: Paycheck Calculator: Take Home
apps.description: See your US take-home pay after federal withholding, FICA, state and city wage tax. Compare two job offers side by side and model a raise, bonus or 401(k).

apps.name: Mortgage & Loan Calculator
apps.description: US mortgage calculator with monthly, annual and one-time extra payments, full PITI and PMI, amortization, biweekly comparisons and refinance break-even.

apps.name: Credit Card Payoff Plan
apps.description: Enter your cards and see the month you become debt free. Compare avalanche against snowball, then drag a slider and watch an extra $50 move the date closer.

apps.name: Rental Yield & ROI Calculator
apps.description: Gross and net rental yield, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, IRR and NPV for a buy-to-let, in any currency. Compare cash against financed, or two properties.

apps.name: Dividend Calculator & ETF SIP
apps.description: Project what a portfolio becomes: compound growth, dividend reinvestment, monthly contributions and inflation-adjusted results. Save and compare scenarios.

apps.name: RateRadar
apps.description: RateRadar compares today’s rate with the pair’s 30-day median and 90-day high, backtests the signal and alerts you when it moves.

apps.name: Tipright: Tip Calculator
apps.description: Split a restaurant bill in seconds, tip on the pre-tax subtotal if you prefer, and settle a bill where everyone ordered something different. Offline, free.

apps.name: BMI Calculator
apps.description: Get your BMI in metric or imperial and see where it falls on the scale, plus the exact weight range that puts you in the healthy band for your height.

apps.name: Lean: Body Fat & BMI
apps.description: Estimate body fat from a tape measure with the U.S. Navy method, then get lean mass, fat mass, BMR and daily calories. Every formula cited to its source.

apps.name: Pill Dot
apps.description: Tap the dot and the dose is logged. A medication tracker with no forms, a streak showing your adherence, and reminders scheduled on the phone, not a server.

apps.name: HUSHH
apps.description: Rain, brown noise, a fan, waves and six more looped sounds, with a sleep timer and a screen that dims itself. Keeps playing when the phone locks. Free.

apps.name: Wakey
apps.description: Dismiss the alarm by scanning a barcode in another room, or walking ten steps. Rotating tones stop your brain tuning them out, and snoozing costs you more.

apps.name: Decibel Meter: Noise & dB
apps.description: Measure noise in dB(A), dB(C) or unweighted dB(Z), with min, average and max, a peak history, and a calibration offset to match a real sound level meter.

apps.name: Vitals: Health Insights
apps.description: Apple Health holds years of data and explains none of it. Vitals reads your metrics on the device and surfaces only the changes that are truly significant.

apps.name: AI Memory Journal – Memora
apps.description: Talk to it like a friend and it quietly remembers what matters. The language model runs on your phone, so the things you tell it never reach anybody's server.

apps.name: SpeakLocal — Offline AI Tutor
apps.description: Practise English, Mandarin or Japanese with an on-device AI tutor, scenario conversations and per-turn feedback. The model runs on your phone.

apps.name: VaultMind: ADHD AI Journal
apps.description: Brain-dump in any order and let an on-device model organise it. AES-256 encrypted entries, mood insights, and an AI coach that never sends a word to a server.

apps.name: Recap: On-Device Meeting AI
apps.description: Record a meeting, transcribe it with the phone's own speech engine, and get key points, decisions and action items — locally. English, Cantonese, Mandarin.

apps.name: VAT Refund: Tax Free Shopping
apps.description: The refund on the sign is not the refund you receive. This works out what lands in your hand after the operator fee and currency margin, across 38 countries.

apps.name: Long Weekend Planner
apps.description: Tell it how many leave days you have and it finds the bridges — which days to book so a holiday turns three days off into nine. Forty countries, offline.

apps.name: Travel Checklist
apps.description: Pick a trip type and the list is already written: beach, business, ski or carry-on only. Tick items off and track bag weight against your airline limit.

apps.name: Travel Tools Hub
apps.description: The three things you look up abroad, in one app: a currency converter on ECB rates that works offline, a tip calculator, and a best-time-to-call view.

apps.name: World Clock 世界時鐘
apps.description: Keep the cities you care about on one screen and find the hour that suits everyone. A meeting planner, a time converter and a home screen widget. No account.

apps.name: Nearby
apps.description: Six categories, one tap each: restaurants, vegetarian food, attractions, hotels, transit and public toilets around you — cached, so you save mobile data.

apps.name: Kudasai
apps.description: Photograph a Japanese menu and find out what the dishes are, then build an order and show the counter a Japanese sentence they can read. Runs on the device.

apps.name: 鐵路通 — HK MTR Pass
apps.description: Live next-train times for MTR and Light Rail from the government open data feed, plus fares, first and last trains, and disruption notices. Big type, no login.

apps.name: 九巴通 — 長者版
apps.description: Live bus arrivals with big numbers, big buttons and spoken times. KMB, Citybus, minibus and MTR Bus, with a nearby-stops screen that opens on your location.

apps.name: 香港天氣通 — HK Weather
apps.description: Observatory data with the warnings first: typhoon signal, rainstorm warning, nine-day forecast, air quality and a typhoon track, with change notifications.

apps.name: 慳家通 · 香港超市格價
apps.description: Compare supermarket prices from Consumer Council open data, see the real price per kilo or litre, track a basket, and get told when a watched item drops.

apps.name: 香港泊車王 — HK Parking
apps.description: Live vacancy counts and hourly rates for Hong Kong car parks from government open data, plus mall discounts, a fee calculator and vacancy alerts for favourites.

apps.name: HK Call Guard
apps.description: Screen nuisance calls against a blocklist held on your phone. No contact upload, no call log upload — matching happens on the device, and you can add numbers.

apps.name: 智駕通 — 香港過海北上泊車助手
apps.description: Rank the three harbour crossings by live journey time and toll before you pick a lane, watch the traffic cameras, and check the queue before a border run.

apps.name: 即急即廁
apps.description: Live waiting times for all 18 public A&E departments, sorted by how far away they are, plus the nearest public toilets. Two urgent searches, one small app.

apps.name: 避暑助手 — HeatSafe HK
apps.description: The official heat index weights direct sun at 5%; international WBGT weights it at 20%. This computes both from Observatory data, so you see the real gap.

apps.name: 車到未 - 香港巴士到站時間 小巴
apps.description: KMB, Citybus, NLB, MTR Bus and green minibus in one search, with the whole route database on the device so the first screen appears before the network does.

apps.name: 住得到 — 香港樓市模擬遊戲
apps.description: Chase the Hong Kong home-owner dream in a game where the prices are real — viewings, haggling, a mortgage application and a daily market puzzle. A game only.

apps.name: 難搵工
apps.description: Send out CVs, sit through interviews, spot the fake listings and keep paying rent as the money runs down. A Hong Kong job-hunt simulation, in Cantonese.

apps.name: 工地投訴 Site Watch
apps.description: Log a construction-site issue with a photo, category and optional location. Keep records on the phone with follow-ups, a map and search.

apps.name: GPS Camera: Timestamp & Map
apps.description: Stamp GPS coordinates, address and time onto photos or video for construction records and insurance claims. Works offline and saves location in EXIF.

apps.name: CleanScan: PDF Scanner OCR
apps.description: Offline PDF scanner with OCR, shadow removal and password-protected PDFs. Search invoices by date, amount or store name; files stay on your device.

apps.name: Passport Rush
apps.description: Passport Rush is an Android arcade runner with a travel theme, 30 destination rules, daily missions and collectible passport postcards.

apps.name: Payday Compass
apps.description: Plan spending between paydays with Payday Compass: track bills, savings goals, a protected buffer, daily spending pace and weekly or monthly insights.

apps.name: Bead Shop: 拼豆工坊
apps.description: Download Bead Shop: 拼豆工坊 free on Google Play. Relax with 100 bead-art levels, play offline, collect patterns, and grow your own cozy shop.
